description: The pie chart represents the distribution of languages in the OpenAssistant Conversations dataset. The chart is divided into 9 slices, with the largest slice labeled "English" in dark blue, accounting for approximately 42.8% of the total. The second-largest slice is "Spanish" in light blue, making up around 31.4%. The remaining slices are "Russian" (5.7%), "German" (3.6%), "French" (2.9%), "Chinese" (1.9%), "Thai" (1.7%), and "Portuguese (Brazil)" (1.6%), with the last slice labeled "Other" in grey, comprising 5.8%. The chart includes percentage labels inside the larger slices, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size, with the largest slices labeled directly on the chart and the smaller slices labeled in a radial arrangement outside the chart.
